name: run a live Postgres service with app credentials exposed via env
definition: Start Postgres, create the app role/db, keep it live, and expose the connection string via DATABASE_URL.
failure_mode: the service going down before grading, or a bad role/password, makes the connection/query tests fail

name: run a local package-index server on a specific port serving a package directory
definition: Launch a package-index server bound to a host:port that serves the built package from a package directory.
failure_mode: Server not running, wrong port, or unindexed package fails the install.
